mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM blogs WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, title, content, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM blogs WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blogs(title, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE blogs SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE blogs SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
